questions.q: What do you usually do in your free time?
questions.answer: It varies with my mood. Often I'll read or listen to music, and if I have more time I'll meet friends or watch a film. I try to spend it on things that genuinely relax me rather than mindless [[scrolling]].

questions.q: Do you prefer spending your free time alone or with others?
questions.answer: A mixture, really. After a long day with students, I often need some quiet time alone to recover. But at weekends I actively seek out friends, because I'd feel quite [[isolated]] without them.

questions.q: How do you relax after a busy day?
questions.answer: Usually with something simple. I'll read, listen to music, or watch an episode of a show. Anything that lets me properly [[decompress]] from work does the trick.

questions.q: Do you have enough free time?
questions.answer: Not really, if I'm honest. Between work and study, my weekdays fill up fast. I [[safeguard]] my weekends fiercely, but I do wish I had a little more downtime during the week.

questions.q: Do you think people have less free time today than in the past?
questions.answer: In a sense, yes. People work longer hours and are constantly connected, so leisure time gets squeezed. Ironically, though, much of our free time is now spent on screens rather than genuinely [[fulfilling]] activities.
